worked_solution:
The given expression is a subtraction of two factorials.

- Computing $3!$ using the definition, we get

$$
3!=3\cdot 2\cdot 1=6.
$$

- By definition, the factorial of zero equals one:

$$
0!=1
$$

Finally, we can evaluate the given expression:

$$
\begin{aligned}3!-0! & =6-1=5\end{aligned}
$$

$$

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{dy}{dx} & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(-3{x}^{-7}) \\  & =-3\cdot \frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}({x}^{-7}) \\  & =-3\cdot (-7){x}^{-7-1} \\  & =21{x}^{-8} \\  & =\frac{21}{{x}^{8}}\end{aligned}
$$
